singapore.title: 'When we have Halloween Horror Night at home': Singapore neighbourhoods go all out with spooky decorations
singapore.summary: From Woodgrove and Watten Estate to Chip Bee Gardens and Sembawang, residents transformed their homes and streets with Halloween decorations, costumes and trick-or-treating activities.

singapore.title: Parliament to discuss haze, proposed COE changes and public healthcare disruptions
singapore.summary: MPs filed more than 50 questions on the transboundary haze, as well as questions on proposed COE changes, disruptions to public healthcare services and the fatal abuse of an eight-month-old baby.

singapore.title: SGIFF Silver Screen Awards 2026: Singapore film Ah Girl wins best film
singapore.summary: The Silver Screen Awards also recognised performances by Pushpa Thing Lama and Putri Marino, alongside Singapore experimental animator Exyl's Singapore God, which won Best Singapore Short Film, as well as Best Director Shahrbanoo Sadat.

singapore.title: Noise complaints halt outdoor music events at Tanjong Pagar Distripark, organisers rue loss of venue
singapore.summary: The Keppel Road venue's capacity and accessibility make it suitable for such large-scale events, said organisers, adding that it's difficult to find similar venues at affordable rates.

singapore.title: Matsuya's first Singapore outlet serves up hearty beef bowls, cheesy curry rice, grilled eel and more
singapore.summary: The 60-year-old Japanese chain opened on Saturday (Oct 31). 8days tried its gyudon and curry rice to see how they stack up against the competition.

singapore.title: New Horse Noodles not closing after all, but only one brother staying on as hawker
singapore.summary: Scott Lee, 29, is giving the Chinatown stall another shot, while brother Troy, 31, is leaving hawker life behind. What changed for the siblings who once said the lifestyle wasn’t what they wanted?

singapore.title: Man with mental condition jailed for attempting to kill stranger at Kallang Wave Mall
singapore.summary: The victim, a 31-year-old woman, was drinking with her boyfriend and acquaintance at Kallang Wave Mall when she went to the toilet and was attacked.

singapore.title: Singapore haze: 24-hr PSI readings in good-to-moderate range islandwide
singapore.summary: 1-hour PM2.5 readings are in the normal range across all regions.

singapore.title: Chemotherapy left her feet too swollen for shoes but this single mum kept running: 'It saved my life'
singapore.summary: Cassandra Hie started running to cope with her divorce, then kept going through breast cancer and chemotherapy. Now 53, the single mum is a competitive runner and Hyrox athlete with more than 10 top-three finishes since her cancer diagnosis.

singapore.title: Commentary: What revised Maju Forest plans could mean for future development decisions
singapore.summary: Framing the outcome in terms of winners and losers risks reinforcing the zero-sum thinking we should move beyond, says NUS landscape architecture professor Yun Hye Hwang.

singapore.title: Singapore’s wine scene has come a long way. The world is taking notice
singapore.summary: Once a small market with limited selection and challenging storage conditions, Singapore has grown into a destination for international wine events, auctions and a thriving community of enthusiasts.

singapore.title: SIA plane tilts during Perth landing attempt amid strong winds, pilots perform go-around
singapore.summary: At one point, the SIA plane tilted noticeably, with one wing appearing to come close to the ground.

singapore.title: Oil patches spotted in Singapore's southern waters; source under investigation: MPA
singapore.summary: No oil was seen near West Coast, Sentosa, the Southern Islands or East Coast during aerial surveillance, the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore said.

singapore.title: Heavy traffic expected at Singapore-Malaysia land checkpoints during Deepavali long weekend
singapore.summary: The Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) issued the travel advisory for Nov 6 to Nov 9, encouraging travellers to plan their journey ahead of time and consider travelling during non-peak hours.

singapore.title: Over 1,300 BTO flats with shorter waiting time of under 3 years to be offered in Sembawang in November
singapore.summary: Flats with a waiting time of just over three years at projects in Bayshore and Tengah will also be launched for sale in the November BTO sales exercise.
